subject: MAP orientation & ops runbook — pre-call checklist and Zoom details
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia@novagear.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: MAP orientation & ops runbook — pre-call checklist and Zoom details

Hi Amelia —

Thanks again for the time last week. To keep momentum toward your eval and the proposed October close, I’ve put together a short MAP orientation call to align stakeholders, confirm evaluation scopes, and run a quick tech/ops checklist so the eval environment can be stood up without surprises.

Proposed time: Oct 4, 2026 · 30 min
Zoom (provisional): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=MAPlaunch

Draft agenda (attached):
- 5m Introductions & objectives
- 10m Evaluation scope and acceptance criteria
- 10m Ops readiness (network, samples, dataset access, keys)
- 5m Next steps & owners

Could you confirm the attendee list on your side and whether the provisional Zoom works? If IT needs a different meeting host or a phone-in, let us know and we’ll accommodate.

Attachments: [Attachment: MAP-Agenda-v1.docx (docx)]

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
---
Onboarding timeline note: we’ll aim to have the evaluation infra live within 48 hours of sign-off on the access checklist.
From: Amelia Torres <amelia@novagear.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Morales <diego.morales@novagear.com>, ops@novagear.com
Date: 2026-09-30T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP orientation & ops runbook — pre-call checklist and Zoom details

Hi Vivek —

Oct 4 works for us; Diego (IT) and our Head of Data, Priya Singh, will join. ops@ is our shared mailbox for infra tickets. Please add Diego and Priya to any runbooks you share.

Also: for security review we’ll need an exported list of what permissions the evaluation service requires (S3 read, limited writes, network egress). Can you attach a one‑page ops checklist for our IT?

—Amelia
Amelia Torres | Director, Product 
NovaGear
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia@novagear.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP orientation & ops runbook — pre-call checklist and Zoom details

Thanks Amelia — I’ve attached a short ops runbook draft and a one‑page permission checklist for Diego / ops@. The runbook includes: required ports, example IAM role/policy for S3 access, token handling recommendations, and a fallback contact for the private deployment path.

Quick asks for the call so we can keep it tight:
- Confirm primary technical attendee (Diego or another person).
- Confirm sample dataset share method (S3 link vs secure ShareFile).
- Let us know if you require our team to join from a specific AWS region for network testing.

I’ll be online 5 minutes early to do a host handoff and test screen share. Attached: ops-runbook-draft.pdf

Best,
Monica
Monica Patel | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ops-runbook-draft.pdf (pdf)]

Date: 2026-10-01T10:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP orientation & ops runbook — pre-call checklist and Zoom details

Quick confirmation — I’ll cover evaluation KPIs and the acceptance criteria section on the call.

If anyone on NovaGear’s side wants to share a short pre-read (one or two bullet lists of success metrics) we’ll slot it into the 10m evaluation scope block.

Ben
Ben Carter | Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Diego Morales <diego.morales@novagear.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Amelia Torres <amelia@novagear.com>, ops@novagear.com
Date: 2026-10-01T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP orientation & ops runbook — pre-call checklist and Zoom details

Thanks all — Diego here (IT). I confirm I’ll join Oct 4. We’ll provide an S3 pre-signed URL for the dataset by EOD Oct 2 and I’ve reviewed the one‑page checklist — OK to the permissions listed. One note: our security team prefers token rotation every 24 hours for short evals — is Redwood able to support that during the evaluation window?

I’ll also add our internal ticket for the network test so you have the request in ops@.

Diego
Diego Morales | IT Operations, NovaGear
